about: Vetted photographs for place and product pages, dealt by scripts/photos.mjs. Unsplash photographs are served by Lorem Picsum (picsum.photos) under the Unsplash License; a Wikimedia Commons file keeps the licence it names (CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, or the Public Domain Mark, whose licenceUrl is the Mark's own page). The two later ingests (sets ingest-001-* and ingest-002-*), looked at again at full size by two reviewers each (27 dropped from ingest 1; of the 8 that ingest 2 kept, 1 is dealt, the cafe tamping hands, and 3 office rooms are weak with no file), hold Commons photographs of bread ovens, florists' benches, smithies, roasteries, bike parts, guesthouse details and Nordic land: their WebP files ship in assets/photos/img (always a 1200, some also a 1600, 1800, 2144 or 2400, none over the weight caps in a srcset) and fetch copies them, so a build needs no network for those. Every entry keeps its photographer (by), licence and source page: photos.mjs credits prints them as one footer line that opens the list. A photograph is a library frame: stock of another place, a detail or process slot at most (references/photos.md), never the client's room, product, shopfront or people. Looked at photograph by photograph: no faces, whole figures, animals, vehicles, landmarks, logos or violet; a photograph of a trade shows its subject (the oven, the roasting, the stems), never mood. A whole figure is flagged (people: figure) and never dealt; a photograph rated below 7 is never dealt. A trade's held counts are never written in this file: photos.mjs list prints them live (detail frames dealt by default, land, leads).

fields.subject: what kind of picture it is, for placing it: bar (the bar at work: espresso, milk, a grinder, a tray, hands or backs only), roast (roasting and green beans), drink, breakfast, food, hands, detail (a room or table detail that belongs to no one), desk, street, road, landscape, building, texture, sky, plant, bike (a whole bicycle), part (a bicycle part), load (what a bike carries)
fields.motif: the main thing in it, so one deal never repeats it
fields.trades: the trades it may be dealt to (see trades); a trade may list only (the subjects it deals: a bike shop only parts and loads) and ownLand (a hotel, a tour, a spa: land, roads, streets and skies are only ever the client's own: dealt only with --own-land and a --place whose name the source names)
fields.lead: strong, wide and landscape: may open a draft or the short page full-bleed, only with --draft-lead (a library frame never leads a finished page: PH-02)
fields.calm: the quiet side where text may sit (none: keep text off it)
fields.focus: where its subject sits (object-position, x y): fetch puts it on the , so a phone's squarer crop keeps the subject
fields.wide: its subject runs across the whole width (a row of three): shown at its own ratio at every width (--ratio: 66.7% on its frame), never cropped taller
fields.shows: it shows a product of that kind (a bicycle): never dealt to a maker of it, only to a shop that sells or fixes every make (--shop)
fields.where: its source names these places, the most exact first (a village, then a region, then the country): dealt only when --place names the first exactly, or names a broader place the photograph lies in (--place Iceland deals every photograph of Iceland; --place "Reykjavik, Iceland" none of the Westfjords and none tagged only Iceland); whole names only, so "Senjavegen" is not Senja; a land frame needs --own-land as well; the place goes in its alt text, never in a caption
fields.moodOnly: its file names a business or shows another's identifiable room: mood only. Never dealt as the lead, in a trade whose pages hold the client's own room, counter, rooms or product (cafe, hotel, bike, food, shop, farm, wine, bar, bakery, florist, workshop), nor into a section that is the client's premises or work (rooms, bar, workshop, range, studio, visit); only a mood, story or closing section of another trade. Never captioned as the client's
fields.cliche: the trade's stock shot (latte art from above or with cake, bowls or piles of beans, a made bed): never dealt
fields.night: night or neon: never dealt to a day trade
fields.warm: a sunny coast: never dealt with a northern --place
fields.terrain: every kind of land a landscape, road or sky shows: --setting only narrows frames whose source names no place (a snowy fjord never stands for a sunny coast); a frame whose named place matches --place overrides it
fields.small: under 1600 pixels wide: a row or a half-width picture, never full-bleed
fields.prints: one clear subject on a plain ground: the kind a photo object (assets/objects/photo-*) can print on a software page; never printed on a place page, nor as a hero or a section's main photograph
fields.orientation: landscape, portrait or square, from ratio (width / height)
fields.quality: the rating looked at full size (Unsplash 3 to 9, Commons 5 to 9): below 7 (the soft, hazy, foggy and snapshot files) is never dealt and never leads; the q4 fog, haze and cloud files are out of hotel, outdoors and wellness altogether; a lead is 7 or more
fields.people: people are in it but never as faces: hands, backs, a face out of frame. "figure": a whole person stands in it, however small (a surfer, a runner, a figure in fog): never dealt, neither as the lead nor in a section
fields.house: one house stands alone in it and would pass for the client's own: never dealt to a hotel or guesthouse
fields.weak: below the set, or a mood frame the skill forbids (a curtain or plant shadows, a sky, fog, an aurora, a waterfall, an animal, a vehicle, a recognisable viewpoint: PH-03). Kept with its credit and its why for the record, no file on disk, never dealt; a whole room (a meeting room, a lounge, a breakfast room) is weak for the same reason a whole room is never dealt
fields.needsSetting: a frame that reads as one kind of place (a snowy fjord from the air, a snowy ridge in a window): dealt only when --setting names all its terrain, and a land frame only with --own-land and its named place
fields.files: local WebP files, smallest first: [{ w: real width, file: path under assets/photos }]. fetch copies them (no download): 1200 always, some also 1600, 1800, 2144 or 2400. A file over the cap (hero 400 KB, other 250 KB) is left out of the srcset. The hero's 2x at 1440 (2880) is not in the library
fields.lqip: a 24 px WebP data URI of the picture: fetch --lqip puts it behind the so a slow connection shows its colours, never an empty frame
fields.craft: the craft it shows (smith, weaving, printing, wood, instrument, bookbinding): another business's work unless the brief names that craft. A craft in --trade (blacksmith, loom, letterpress, bindery) deals only that craft; no craft named deals none of them (a smithy is never a weaver's bench, a bookshop never shows a bookbinder's hands)
fields.licenceTag: the Commons licence tag as the file page prints it (PD-author-FlickrPDM): the licence is the Public Domain Mark 1.0, licenceUrl its page; no permission is needed, the photographer is still named
fields.why: weak entries: why it is never dealt (kept with its credit for the record; no file is copied)
fields.mood: one line: the feeling of the frame, for choosing between two of one subject; never copy
fields.light: one line: the light it was taken in; one deal keeps to one light
fields.soft: soft at the edges, a blown or cluttered ground, or an uneven snapshot that passed the full-size review only just: dealt last, after every sharper frame of its subject (never first in a section), never the lead

cafe.for: a café, a coffee bar, a roastery
cafe.show: the coffee being made at the bar (espresso running, milk poured, a tray carried along the bar, hands only or seen from behind), the roasting (beans dropping into the cooling tray, green beans in a hand) and the cup on a table or terrace
cafe.never: another café's room, counter front, sign or printed cups; a machine or grinder showing its maker's name; latte art from above or a latte-art close-up as the hero, beans filling the frame, burlap sacks; the croissant-and-cappuccino still life; a curtain, plant or window standing in for the bar; a face as staff or guest; three bowls of beans on white; cake beside the cups; another place's street behind the cup as the visit section (visit and menu sections are dealt nothing)

hotel.for: a guesthouse, an inn, a hotel, a cabin, holiday rooms
hotel.show: where the house stands, when the library holds that place (--place); for its rooms the details that belong to no one (linen in window light, a pillow, a window seat, wool blankets); breakfast as it is served (bread and butter, porridge, a jug and a bowl)
hotel.never: a whole furnished room (it would pass for this house's room); a made bed or folded towels; a guest in bed; a pool at sunset; a city skyline; any landscape that is not the client's own place (--place): fog, haze and skies included

bike.for: a bike shop, a repair workshop or a rental that sells or fixes every make (--shop); a maker of its own bike is a product without photographs: no deal
bike.show: with --shop: parts close up for the workshop (hub, chain, cassette) and a basket load, nothing else; the hero, the range and the shop itself are the shop's own photographs
bike.never: mood stock for a product (forests, roads, weather, umbrellas, groceries); another maker's bike as the client's model; cars, vans, motorbikes

food.for: a deli, a farm shop, a grocer, a market stall (a restaurant shows its own dishes and room: no deal; a bakery is its own trade)
food.show: produce and ingredients close: vegetables in a crate, berries, honey, grapes, wheat in the field
food.never: a plated dish standing for the client's menu (its menu is type, or its own photographs); flat lays from above

studio.for: a design, architecture or creative studio, an agency
studio.show: light and material: white walls and stairs, facades, paper and card, concrete
studio.never: anyone's work shown as the studio's; a desk with a laptop and a plant

office.for: an office, a coworking space, a firm or practice (a software page leads with its product, not these)
office.show: modern buildings and calm interiors reduced to a detail: facades, glass, a notebook and pencil on a desk, card and paper; never a whole room
office.never: hands on a laptop, a team round a screen, a handshake; a whole meeting room, lounge or open-plan floor (it would pass for the client's own office: the library holds none)

shop.for: a shop of goods, gifts or homewares
shop.show: the street at its door, materials, flowers and light on a table
shop.never: another maker's goods as the shop's own; another shop's window

books.for: a publisher, a bookshop, stationery, a writing school, a writing tool's about page
books.show: the desk the writing is done at: a pencil on an open notebook, paper and bindings close; never hands writing beside a laptop
books.never: a typewriter or old letters; a page whose words can be read; a laptop as the subject

outdoors.for: a tour, a guide, an outdoor school, a campsite
outdoors.show: the landscape it goes to: coast, mountains, forest, water, roads
outdoors.never: a hiker or guest presented as a customer; a place it does not go to (use --place)

wellness.for: a spa, a sauna, a yoga or treatment studio, a clinic
wellness.show: water, fog, forest, plants, pebbles and linen: calm surfaces
wellness.never: a silhouette at sunrise; a stethoscope; a person posing

farm.for: a farm, a market garden, a nursery (a florist is its own trade)
farm.show: the fields, the produce in crates and hands, plants and flowers close

wine.for: a winery, a vineyard, a wine shop
wine.show: where it grows: grapes on the vine, grapes in hands, golden hills
wine.never: a glass swirled against the light; another winery's bottle or cellar

bar.for: a bar, a taproom, a night venue
bar.show: a detail of the bar at work (the glass rack on the wall, hands straining a drink); never a bar's room
bar.never: another bar's whole room, back bar or sign (a named bar's interior is mood only and never dealt as the client's room); a readable bottle label; neon; a face

bakery.for: a bakery, a bread oven, a stall or van that sells bread (a patisserie shows its own cakes: no deal)
bakery.show: the oven at work (loaves on the oven floor, the iron doors open, the lit mouth of the oven), dough proving in baskets, loaves on their shelves
bakery.never: a croissant or cake still life, a hand in flour held up to the camera, flour on black, another bakery's counter, shopfront, sign or bag, a face as staff; a frame as the client's own oven or bake room (they are other people's ovens: process, never premises)

florist.for: a florist, a flower shop or stall (a farm's market garden is farm)
florist.show: hands at the bench trimming stems and wrapping a bouquet (faces out of frame), buds standing in a bucket
florist.never: a finished bouquet on white, a wedding arch, roses in a heart, a vase on a table, another florist's shopfront or sign, a face

workshop.for: a craft workshop or a maker's studio: a smithy, a joinery, weaving, letterpress, a repair bench (pottery and ceramics are not held; a bike workshop is bike --shop)
workshop.show: hands at the work and the tools of that craft only (a hammer on a glowing bar, tongs, an anvil; warp threads; drawers of type): name the craft in --trade (blacksmith, weaving, letterpress) so a smith's page is never dealt a weaver's bench
workshop.never: another craft's work (a smithy on a joiner's page), a face or a whole figure, a maker's name plate, a museum's tool wall as the client's bench, mood in place of the work
